biotools.summary: JASEN is a bioinformatics pipeline developed by Genomic Medicine Sweden for the analysis of whole-genome sequencing data, particularly for surveillance of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus. It facilitates standardized data sharing and analysis among multiple laboratories, yielding comparable results for outbreak clustering.
